single.rationale: BlackLine shows solid fundamentals with consistent revenue growth (10.2% 3-year CAGR), improving profitability (operating margin turned positive), and strong free cash flow generation (23% FCF margin). However, revenue growth decelerated sharply to 7.2% in FY2025, management cited macroeconomic headwinds causing customer purchasing delays, and the company underwent multiple restructuring programs indicating operational challenges. The recent AI investments (Verity launch, WiseLayer acquisition) and platform pricing transition offer upside potential but execution risk remains elevated.
